summary: An April Fools' RFC that takes a humorous look at the tangle of three letter acronyms. It pretends to give IANA considerations so that one acronym does not have several expansions. It is not a real standard and should be read as a joke.

eli5.summary: Many different things share the same three-letter nickname, which causes mix-ups. This joke note pretends to sort them all out with serious-sounding rules, but it is really just for fun.

questions: is there an april fools rfc about acronyms
